operations_gallery.name: Operations Gallery
operations_gallery.description: A synthesis wall, 1.38 m square: four slate panels in a two-by-two block, each giving a different account of ONE run of Euclid's algorithm. outcome rules the a-by-b rectangle into gcd-sized tiles and says nothing about how the size was found. trace cuts the rectangle into Euclid's own squares, graded from brass to blue by which division step made them, with a step gauge above it against a fixed ceiling of eight. operands lays the two lengths against a 24-unit rule that never moves, each bar notched at every unit so it is counted and not merely long. expression writes the recurrence out and substitutes this pair, one line per division. All four are read from a single descent computed once at build time. Nothing moves, nothing is random, and there is no per-frame code in the file.
dev_themes: what a machine will show of its own operation
the family word as the exhibit
disclosure has a cost and the cost is in the input
interactions: read the four panels left to right, top row first — the family's own order
set the wall to exact and notice the four accounts nearly agree
set it to adversarial and notice the outcome panel has not changed much while the trace panel has
compare coprime and adversarial: the same answer, two steps against six
operations_gallery.capacity: SEE that the four values of `workings` are not four amounts of the same thing. Three of them are readings of one event and the fourth is a reading of the law that produced it, and how far apart they land depends on the input, not on the machine.
operations_gallery.qfep_connection: F is the descent: one rule, evaluated once, identical behind all four panels, which is why the wall is a comparison and not four drawings. E is the four accounts, and they are not reducible to each other — a tiling cannot be recovered from a written recurrence and neither can be recovered from two bars. lambda is how much of its own operation a machine is willing to put on the table. The dark spot is `outcome` at a coprime pair: a plate with no structure in it, which is a complete and honest answer and also indistinguishable from a plate that was never computed.
operations_gallery.relationships:
Synthesised out of the twenty-six registry entries that declare a `workings` axis. Every one was read — the registry block and the code — before the word was taken.

[[transform_composition_workbench]] is the origin of the majority vocabulary and this artifact PRELOADS it. Fourteen of the nineteen members name it in their own doc blocks as where the word, the four values and their order came from, so its `const WORKINGS` is the family's table and this wall walks it at build time instead of retyping it. That is slot_machine's discipline, taken from prng_crank_machine, and the reason is the same: class_name lookups are not reliable headless, and every frame of the evidence loop is rendered headless. It is also the member whose four descriptions are the sharpest — `trace` there does not add to `outcome`, it REPLACES the direct arrows with a bent two-segment one — which is the observation this wall is built on.

[[length_lantern]] is the housing sibling and its palette is taken character for character: SLATE_COLOR Color(0.10, 0.11, 0.14) and BRASS_COLOR Color(0.72, 0.55, 0.22). It is also the member closest in subject — a magnitude drawn with its construction shown — and its registry line that the scaffolding 'was never optional before' is the family complaint this gallery answers.

[[adder_board]] is the member that stated the failure mode this wall had to design around: 'only VISIBILITY is gated, every mesh is still built and still positioned', so its AABB is byte-identical at all four values. Here the opposite discipline applies — the four panels are all built at once and it is the OPERATION that turns — so the union AABB is constant for a different and better reason, and the camera cannot be reading three magnifications of one picture.

[[bounce_well]] contributed the pivot test: it names, per value, which mass of pixels moves ('the arcs are the pivot: ~100 emissive spheres are the brightest mass in any frame, and outcome is the only value that takes them out'). This wall's equivalent is stated in still_note, per panel, with numbers.

[[evidence_ladder]] is the structural precedent and the constraint is borrowed rather than quoted: one phenomenon integrated ONCE at build time and drawn N ways side by side, so nothing on the bench can disagree with anything else on it. Its C_LATE Color(0.35, 0.76, 1.0) is this wall's cold end, so a graded history reads the same way on both objects. Its ruling on `evidence` — that the family word cannot be the axis of the artifact that exhibits it — is applied here to `workings`.

[[retention_corridor]] is the other precedent, and it supplied the declared-order rule used below: default first, then descending separation, so a truncated sweep drops the closest pair rather than keeping it.

[[wfc_tile_bench]] is the minority dialect's clearest statement and the reason dna.kin says two questions rather than one wording: 'wave function collapse does not draw a picture; it deletes every picture that breaks a rule and shows you what is left'. Nothing on this wall is deleted, so `trial` and `reject` have nothing here to name.

It replaces none of them. Meeting one artifact standing in one disclosure is the curriculum; this is the wall for the visitor who wants the comparison.

measurements.measured_by: computed from the script's layout constants, read back out of the file by script rather than retyped. MeshInstance3D only, which is what the capture AABB counts. x and y are the back slab (the bezels reach 1.34 and sit inside it); z runs from the slab's back face at -0.05 to the bezel front at +0.024. The Label3D nodes are not counted by the capture and all six sit inside this box.

parameters.divisibility: adversarial | exact | shared | coprime - which pair of whole numbers the gallery runs Euclid's algorithm on (default adversarial)

dna.default:
divisibility=adversarial (21 and 13). A SYNTHESIS HAS NO SHIPPED PLACEMENTS, so there is no pre-promotion behaviour for a default to preserve and the choice is free — and it was used to pick the STRONGEST single reading rather than the emptiest, which is the rule for this case.

WHY THE HARDEST PAIR AND NOT THE PLAINEST. This wall exists to show that four accounts of one operation can disagree. At `exact` they very nearly do not: 24 = 3 x 8 in one step, and the outcome tiling and the trace decomposition are the SAME THREE SQUARES up to colour (measured: they differ over 112% of the outcome panel's ink, against 200% at adversarial — and most of that 112% is the step ramp, not the geometry). A gallery whose default is the value where its own subject is least visible would be an exhibit apologising for itself. At `adversarial` the four panels are as far apart as this scale can put them: a featureless unit mesh, a six-stage spiral, two nearly equal bars, and eleven written lines.

It is also the value with an argument attached. 21 and 13 is not a picked example — brute force over every pair with a <= 24 returns exactly one pair reaching six division steps, and it is this one. The default is therefore the extremal case of the thing the axis measures, which is a defensible place for a synthesis to stand.
dna.was: nothing. This artifact did not exist before this pass and has zero placements; it is the cross-member argument twenty-six promotions left lying in registry notes, built as a body. No member was modified, no default anywhere else was touched, and no source scene is instanced here.
dna.kin:
THE SPLIT, NAMED. `workings` is declared by 26 registry entries in TWO vocabularies, and the split is clean along a line the corpus did not draw on purpose.

MAJORITY, 19 entries: outcome | trace | operands | expression. transform_composition_workbench, adder_board, length_lantern, stretch_bench, dot_product_projector, vector_addition_demo, vector_subtraction_demo, vector_add, vector_sub, force_mower, bubble_blaster, circle_train, launch_arc, projection_shadow, torque_crank, dot_aligner, bounce_well, geometric_transformations, csg_difference_demo.

MINORITY, 7 entries, all in procedural_generation.json: result | rule | trial | reject. mc_field_bench, sdf_sculpt_bench, wfc_tile_bench, wfc_room_bench, colonization_bench, slime_bench, voronoi_bench.

THIS WALL TAKES THE MAJORITY LIST, and does not retype it: the four panels are built by walking transform_composition_workbench.WORKINGS at build time. A count worth recording while the census was open — 26 registry names sit on 25 scripts, because vector_op_console.gd is the scene behind BOTH vector_add and vector_sub. That is the corpus's most common hidden family and it is honest here: the two tokens measure alike because they are the same object under two names.

ARE THE TWO LISTS THE SAME IDEA IN DIFFERENT WORDS, OR TWO DIFFERENT QUESTIONS? TWO DIFFERENT QUESTIONS, and the evidence is that only half of each list has a counterpart in the other.

The pairs that DO map: result = outcome, the answer with the mechanism sealed, exactly. rule = expression, near enough — though `expression` is the law with THIS instance substituted into it and `rule` is the alphabet posted independent of any instance, which is a real difference in what a still shows.

The halves that do NOT map, in both directions:
  - `trial` and `reject` have no counterpart in the majority. They exist because a generator EXPLORES: trial is other runs that could have been taken, reject is what propagation forbade. Deterministic arithmetic has no other runs and rejects nothing. There is no vector addition that was almost performed.
  - `trace` and `operands` have no counterpart in the minority. A derivation has a unique path and named inputs; a stochastic search has neither. A seed is not an operand, and wfc_tile_bench's own note says the algorithm 'does not draw a picture, it deletes every picture that breaks a rule' — which is a description of something that has no trace in the majority's sense.

So the shared word is honest and the shared list would not have been. Both dialects ask what a machine will show of its own operation; they differ because the operations differ in kind. The majority asks it of a DERIVATION — unique, terminating, with parts. The minority asks it of a SEARCH — non-unique, with alternatives and deletions. A future auditor should read the 26 as two families under one roof, not as a vocabulary that drifted.

AND THAT IS WHY THIS GALLERY'S OPERATION IS A DERIVATION AND NOT A GENERATOR. Euclid's algorithm is deterministic, terminates, has named operands and one path, so all four of the majority's values have something real to show. Running the same wall on a wave function collapse would leave `operands` with a seed to draw.

`workings` IS REFUSED AS THIS ARTIFACT'S OWN AXIS, on the record, and the refusal is the design. All 26 members use the word to stand in ONE disclosure and forgo the other three. Here all four stand at once and that simultaneity IS the object, so an axis whose every value demolishes three quarters of the exhibit is not a variation of it — evidence_ladder's ruling on `evidence`, retention_corridor's on `retention`, and it lands the same way a third time. The word is EXHIBITED instead: it names the artifact, it names the four panels, and it is engraved in brass under each one.

`divisibility` IS THIS ARTIFACT'S OWN WORD and no sibling declares it — checked across every registry file: 422 distinct axis words, `divisibility` is not among them.

`pair` WAS CONSIDERED AND REFUSED. It is the family's nearest word for this idea and it already means exactly this on vector_addition_demo, where pair = oblique | orthogonal | parallel | opposed names the RELATION THE TWO OPERANDS STAND IN. That is the same question this axis asks. It was refused because the word already carries TWO vocabularies (transform_composition declares pair = rotate_translate | rotate_scale | translate_scale | rotate_rotate, which names which pair rather than what kind of pair), and adding a third meaning to a word that is already ambiguous is the disease the corpus audit of 78 multi-vocabulary words exists to flag. Two integers also have no angle, so not one of vector_addition_demo's four answers transfers — and taking a word without its answers is the dishonest half of a shared vocabulary.

`phenomenon` WAS ALSO CONSIDERED AND REFUSED. evidence_ladder uses it for exactly the structural role this axis fills — the event under the exhibit — but its values are fall | throw | bounce | drag, four kinds of MOTION. A gcd is not a fall. Reusing the word and replacing all four answers would leave two artifacts sharing a word and nothing else, which is the state this file's census exists to warn about.
dna.nest_or_side_by_side:
REQUIRED JUDGEMENT, and the answer is BOTH, which is why the wall is built the way it is. Read from the members' code rather than from their prose.

On nearly every member the implementation is the same shape: `trace` is the legacy lineage and falls through adding nothing; `outcome` SUBTRACTS from it (bounce_well calls _unlayer(flight) and takes the arcs out); `operands` and `expression` each ADD a different apparatus on top of the same base — a gauge column and an algebra board respectively — and neither contains the other. So the four are not a ladder. outcome is contained in trace, and operands and expression are two PARALLEL readings standing on trace. The shape is a Y, not a line.

disclosure_cabinet's case is the nesting one: showing all five at once is just the top value, so the family word has to be varied. retention_corridor's is the parallel one: all five stand and something else varies. This family is the parallel case at the top of the Y and the nesting case at its foot, so it belongs with retention_corridor — the four accounts are built at once, and what varies is the operation underneath them.

That is not a technicality. If the four values nested, this wall would be showing `expression` four times at four levels of completeness, and the closest pair would be adjacent rungs. Because they are parallel readings, the four panels can genuinely disagree, and the finding below — that HOW MUCH they disagree depends on the input — is only available at all because they are side by side.
dna.one_arithmetic:
_run() performs Euclid's algorithm once at build time and fills _steps, an Array[Vector4i] of (a, b, q, r) per division, plus _g. It is the only place in the file where / or % is applied to the operands. The outcome panel's tile size is _g; the trace panel's square sides are _steps[i].y and its counts are _steps[i].z, derived in _squares() from that array and never re-divided; its step gauge fills _steps.size() slots; the operands panel's two bars are the axis table's pair; the expression panel prints one line per entry of _steps. Nothing on this wall can drift out of agreement with anything else on it because there is nothing else for it to agree with.

THE COUNT IS THE THING COUNTED, not a proxy for it. The step gauge counts entries in _steps — divisions actually performed — and the expression panel prints the same entries, so the two panels cannot report different amounts of work. The trap being avoided is sorting_hall's, which counted cells whose value changed as a proxy for work and reported that merge sort is free on sorted input.
dna.gauge:
TWO GAUGES, BOTH WITH A CEILING FIXED ACROSS THE WHOLE AXIS.

A_MAX = 24 is the unit ruler. Every length on every panel is drawn at U = 0.52 / 24 = 0.0216667 m per unit, at every value. A 21-unit bar at adversarial is 21/24 of the drawing width and a 24-unit bar at exact fills it. Normalising each frame to its own largest operand would draw a full-width bar at every value and the ruler would say nothing about the quantity it exists to show — sorting_hall's fault, avoided by construction rather than by care.

MAX_STEPS = 8 is the step gauge and the trace panel's colour ramp. The ramp divides by 7 and the gauge draws 8 slots at every value, so a colour means one stage of one descent everywhere on the wall and `adversarial` fills six of eight rather than filling the gauge. The true worst case at this scale is SIX, measured by brute force over all 276 pairs with 1 <= b < a <= 24 rather than assumed, and reached by exactly one pair. The ceiling is set above it on purpose: a gauge whose largest value fills it cannot be told from a gauge that is clipping.

EVERY MARK CHECKED AGAINST THE FRAME'S px-PER-METRE, computed from dna.framing below: 499.5 px/m, and 8.81 px horizontal per drawing unit after the sweep's yaw foreshortening of cos(0.62) = 0.814. Unit notch on an operands bar 0.004 m = 1.8 px at an 8.81 px pitch, so a bar reads as a comb; it was 0.003 m = 1.4 px on the first pass and was widened. Tile seam 0.005 m = 2.03 px. Trace rectangle edge 0.005 m = 2.3 px, widened from 0.004. Step gauge cell 25.2 x 33.8 px. Outcome tile width 70.5 px at exact, 26.4 at shared, 8.8 at adversarial and coprime. Expression line pitch 0.0432 m, DERIVED from the label's own metrics (font_size 48 x pixel_size 0.00072 = 0.03456 m plus line_spacing 12 x 0.00072) rather than chosen, so the two brass rules bracket the block instead of floating off it. This is foresight_range's fault answered in advance: its 0.028 m arrows on an 18 m lane measured 0.01%.
dna.framing_why:
ARITHMETIC, AND IT CHANGED THE OBJECT. Mesh AABB 1.38 x 1.38 x 0.074, diagonal 1.9530, radius 0.9765. capture_config_sweep fits by DIAGONAL — dist = radius / tan(FOV/2) x PAD x framing at FOV 34 and PAD 1.9 — so the visible frame is simply 2 x PAD x radius x framing = 3.7107 x framing metres, the tangent cancelling. At 0.41 the camera stands 2.488 m out, the frame is 1.5214 m, and at the sweep's yaw 0.62 / pitch -0.26 the wall projects to 1.166 x 1.353 m: 76.6% of frame width and 88.9% of its height, subject about 68% of frame. Height binds, not width, and 0.41 is set to leave 11% of the frame's height as margin.

DERIVED FROM THE UNION AABB and not from the default, which here is free: the furniture is identical at every value, and every drawing is bounded by its panel by construction — the widest rectangle is 24 units = DRAW_W exactly, the tallest is 15 units = 0.325 m against a 0.62 m face, and the expression block's eleven lines at adversarial reach -0.235 against a -0.31 panel edge. So the union across all four values IS the furniture, and no value can move the camera.

AND THE SHAPE OF THE WALL IS THIS ARITHMETIC'S DOING. The gallery was first laid out the way the brief describes it, as four stations along a 2.86 m bench, and rasterised before anything was built. That geometry is width-bound: the frame can never be tighter than the projected row, 2.386 m, so px/m is capped near 287 and the four drawings come to 10% of frame. The measured pairwise differences were 0.84% to 1.80%, mean 1.32% — under the bite floor, and for exactly the reason evidence_ladder came back at 0.60% with a healthy 32.4% subject. A row of N panels has 1/N the frame share of one panel; a 2x2 block has 1/2. Folding the row into a square block moved the same four panels from 24% of frame to 28% of the frame's drawing area at 1.74x the linear resolution, and the mean pairwise difference from 1.32% to 6.02%. The brief offered the choice of layout and this is the measurement that took it. The four panels are still read in the family's order — top row left to right, then the bottom row — and the order is still walked out of the owner's const, not typed here.
dna.determinism: No randf, no randi, no randomize, no RandomNumberGenerator anywhere in the file — checkable, not claimed. No _process, no _physics_process, no Timer, no tween, no signal. _ready is ungated and builds the whole wall standalone, so no dna.fixture is needed and none is declared. Two captures of one value are two photographs of one object, and a settle time cannot photograph this artifact half way through anything.
dna.predicted_degeneracy:
COMPUTED BEFORE ANY CAPTURE, by rasterising all four panels at all four values at the sweep's own resolution and foreshortening — 760 px, framing 0.41, yaw 0.62, pitch -0.26, tone-aware rather than binary because the critic compares pixel values and the trace panel is graded by step. The script is arithmetic, not a render; a sweep should falsify it.

THE CLOSEST PAIR IS adversarial vs coprime, AT 4.18% OF FRAME, and it is the pair this artifact is about. 21:13 and 23:11 have the same answer (gcd 1), nearly the same rectangle (273 against 253 square units) and nearly the same two bars. Per panel: outcome 0.60%, trace 3.00%, operands 0.18%, expression 0.39%. So the OUTCOME PANEL — the account that seals the mechanism — is within 0.60% of frame of being unable to tell a two-step descent from a six-step one, while the trace panel is five times further apart. That is the artifact's whole claim, stated in advance as a number so that a small figure there is read as a fact about sealed disclosure and not as a broken axis. It is field_room's shape: law=gravity made banded and magnitude identical to the byte, and because the prediction existed the zero was read correctly.

A FIRST, WRONGER PREDICTION IS RECORDED because it was caught by the same arithmetic. The obvious guess was that adversarial and coprime would be IDENTICAL at the outcome panel — same gcd, so the same unit tiling. The raster says 0.60% and not 0.00%, because the two rectangles are different sizes and the tiling silhouette moves with them. The guess was wrong by the width of a rectangle and it would have been reported as a design fault if it had been discovered after the sweep instead of before it.

THE OTHER FIVE PAIRS, for whoever reads the sheet: exact/coprime 4.47%, adversarial/shared 5.27%, shared/coprime 6.35%, adversarial/exact 7.56%, exact/shared 8.30%. Mean over all six 6.02%. Ink per value, as a share of frame: shared 13.65%, adversarial 10.21%, coprime 8.79%, exact 8.03%.

DECLARED ORDER IS adversarial, exact, shared, coprime — default first, then DESCENDING separation from it (7.56, 5.27, 4.18). build_dna_gallery trims value lists from the tail, so a capped sweep drops the closest pair rather than keeping it. This is retention_corridor's rule and not the argument's order, which would run exact, shared, coprime, adversarial; the argument's order is written out in the code's axis block where a reader meets it.
dna.still_note:
WHAT SHOULD MOVE AND WHAT SHOULD NOT, said in advance so a thin number is read rather than filed.

THE FOUR PANELS DO NOT MOVE, EVER. The slab, the four bezels, the four faces, the four engraved words, the operands ruler and its six ticks, the trace panel's eight gauge slots and the expression panel's two brass rules are identical at every value of the axis. That is roughly a third of the wall's ink and it is furniture on purpose: the exhibit's claim is that the four accounts are the same four accounts, and a station that redecorated itself between values would be arguing something else. Every pixel a sweep measures is a mark the OPERATION made.

THE ENGRAVED WORDS ARE THE FAMILY'S AND THEY ARE FIXED. outcome, trace, operands, expression are cut into the four panels and none of them changes with the axis, so no measured difference here can be a caption changing — the info_board fault, avoided by putting the only text that varies inside the two panels whose subject IS text and numerals.

WHERE THE INK IS, per panel, at the default: trace 5.15% of frame, outcome 2.57%, operands 1.62%, expression 0.86%. The trace panel is the pivot the way the arcs are on bounce_well — it holds the most ink at every value and it is the panel that separates the closest pair.

EXPRESSION IS THE WEAKEST PANEL AND IT IS DECLARED WEAK. It carries 0.86% of frame at its fullest (eleven lines at adversarial) and 0.36% at its emptiest (six lines at exact), and the pairwise differences it contributes run 0.19% to 0.50%. It is a quarter of the wall doing a twelfth of the measured work. That is not a fault to be fixed by growing the type — the type is already 0.0432 m per line on a 0.62 m face, and a panel whose account IS a written derivation has as many pixels as the derivation has lines. It is reported here so that nobody later reads the wall's headline number as evenly distributed.

IF IT COMES BACK FAINT, check three things before the design. First the framing: this is a square subject at 68% of frame and 0.41 is tight already, so faintness would be a surprise rather than the usual wide-flat dilution. Second the panel order — if the sweep's tiles show the four panels in an order other than outcome, trace, operands, expression, then transform_composition_workbench.WORKINGS has moved and _check_family() will have pushed an error to the log. Third, whether the critic's hottest-5% window has landed on the trace panel's step ramp, which is the brightest graded mass on the wall and the one thing guaranteed to move.

NO SECOND STANDPOINT HAS BEEN TRIED. Every number above is a prediction about the canonical camera at yaw 0.62, and the wall is a flat frontal object, so an anamorphic surprise is unlikely — but that is a reason, not evidence, and if a value comes back dead it is probe_anamorphic.py's business and not a verdict.
dna.budget: 106 to 112 MeshInstance3D depending on the value, plus 6 Label3D and 9 furniture boxes, with no collision bodies and no static bodies anywhere. The outcome panel's tiling is drawn as ONE filled plate plus its interior seams rather than as a/g x b/g separate tiles: at adversarial that is 34 meshes instead of 273, the identical picture, and it keeps the whole wall two orders of magnitude under the element budget and nowhere near the watchdog. Materials are cached by colour and emission, so a 32-seam plate builds one material and not 32.
declined: `workings` AS THIS ARTIFACT'S AXIS — refused, see dna.kin. It would bite hugely, and that is most of what is wrong with it: three quarters of the frame would change between values because three quarters of the exhibit would be missing. The large number would be a measurement of the wall being taken down.

`workings` AS A SPOTLIGHT — one panel lit, three dimmed. Refused on evidence_ladder's second ground, which transfers unchanged: dimming is MOUNTING. It changes how an exhibit is lit and not what it argues, and that is the one thing an axis may not do.

AN AXIS ON THE OPERATION ITSELF — gcd, then long multiplication, then a sort, then a dot product, one per value. Refused because it is four artifacts wearing one token: nothing would be held constant between values, every panel would change for four unrelated reasons at once, and the wall would stop being a comparison. The brief also asked for ONE operation, and the reason is the same reason.

A TIME AXIS — the descent animated, one division per second, or a reveal that walks the four panels. Real, and invisible to one still. This is the info_board result and the members reached it independently: the evidence is one PNG per value, and a rate has nothing to say to it. The wall's answer is to draw the whole descent standing, which is the only part of an algorithm a photograph was ever able to hold.

AN AXIS ON A_MAX, THE RULER'S CEILING — swept 12, 24, 36, 48. It would move a great deal of ink and it would mean nothing: it is a zoom control. Worse, it would break the one property that makes the four values comparable, since a bar's length would no longer mean the same number at two values of the sweep. It is the frame-relative normalisation this file's gauge block exists to forbid, dressed as an axis.

A SECOND AXIS ON THE SQUARE DECOMPOSITION'S TURN DIRECTION — always cut horizontally, versus alternating. It is still-visible and it is declined because the alternation is not a style choice: cutting the largest square off a rectangle and turning is what the algorithm DOES, and a version that only ever cuts one way is drawing a different recursion. That is LAW 10's case exactly — the more faithful model is the only honest one, and there is no second reading to offer.

INSTANCING THE SOURCE SCENES — a length_lantern, an adder_board and a bounce_well standing in three of the panels. Refused because the sources are live machines with grab points, sliders, console racks and _process loops, and three of them in one scene would be three rooms in a trench coat. What this wall needs from them is their CLAIM and their palette, so the slate, the brass, the cold end of the step ramp and the four words are taken exactly, and nothing else is.
dna.known_gap: NO MAP PLACES THIS ARTIFACT and placement is a separate ruling deliberately not taken here. It is also worth saying plainly that the wall has never been walked: every number in this block is arithmetic performed on the script's own constants, and no Godot process was run, because captures are serialised centrally. The first sweep is the falsification test for dna.predicted_degeneracy, and the number to check first is 4.18% for adversarial against coprime with 0.60% of it at the outcome panel.
